image_description: A close-up photograph of a coral fungus (Ramaria species) growing on the forest floor. The fungus displays a complex, multi-branched structure with numerous cylindrical branches arising from a common base. The coloration is predominantly pale orange to peach, with some branches showing slightly darker pinkish-orange tones. The branches divide repeatedly into finer tips, creating a dense, bushy cluster. The surface appears smooth with a matte finish. The fungus is surrounded by dark soil, decaying leaves, and small twigs, indicating a natural woodland habitat.
